options.items_template: [{% for hit in data.hits %}{"topic": {{ hit.title | tojson }}, "signal_strength": {{ hit.score / 100 }}, "suggested_channel_hint": {{ hit.kind | tojson }}, "reason": {{ hit.why | tojson }}}{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}]

brand_description: Scribe is an AI writing assistant for teams: draft, edit, and keep a consistent voice across docs, and turn messy notes into clean writing.
agent_goal: Grow signups from people searching for writing, editing, and productivity topics.
